name: relocated-report-runtime
goal: Preserve installed and source-relative report runtime paths after helper owner relocation

evidence: The owner-folder move adjusted all runReport module-relative URLs, including two addresses that Bun resolves from the bundled dist/index.js at runtime. That makes an installed binary look outside its package. Source-relative URLs need relocation; installed output-relative URLs do not.

Environment tests check config precedence and packaged acceptance depends on a full build. Extend the existing report-environment suite with a tiny native bundled installation and sibling CLI fixture, testing runtime roots without source fallback or provider access.

Test-only 75391b92 fails the installed-runtime assertion without a source checkout. Immutable red 476ce762b1e3f2b2efa5fd51f6c5159c2385e4300d3e90ed4d8422f0d66f60d3 records the actual bundled launcher exit failure and unchanged environment suite.

Restore the two compiled-output-relative addresses and keep the adjusted source-relative addresses. Exercise a native bundled launcher in the existing environment suite; require source and packaged path review whenever import.meta.url code moves.

Compiled report CLI and Harness CLI addresses again resolve beside dist/index.js. Source-mode URLs retain their new owner-folder depth. The native installed-layout fixture is in normal report environment coverage, and the existing move checkpoint requires both layouts.
